chunks: Hakim ibn Dawud narrated to me from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa, from someone whose name he mentioned, from Dawud ibn Kathir, from Abu Abdillah, who said:
Verily, Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad (peace be upon him), attends to those who visit the grave of her son, al-Husayn (peace be upon him), and she seeks forgiveness for their sins.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: al-Husayn, son of Ali ibn Abi Talib
key_terms.زُوَّارِ: visitors (plural of zayr, one who performs Ziyarah)
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fatimah, daughter of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the role of Fatimah (peace be upon her) during the Ziyarah of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This narration from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the enduring spiritual agency of Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her) as an intercessor for pilgrims visiting the shrine of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him). It reflects the Shia theological emphasis on the continuous presence of the Ahl al-Bayt in the spiritual realm, where their prayers serve as a conduit for divine mercy and forgiveness for those who honor the legacy of Karbala.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Hukaym ibn Dawud narrated to me from Salamah ibn Khaťťāb, from Hassan ibn ‘Ali Al-Washa, from someone whose name he mentioned, from Dawud ibn Kuthayr, who said: Abu ‘Abdillah (Imam Saqdiq (a.s.)) said:
Verily Fatima (a.s), the daughter of Muhammad (s.w), visits those who go to the Ziyarah of the grave of her son, Hussain (a.s.), and she seeks forgiveness for their sins.
